title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of a supermarket site at Giralang in the ACT
targets: Supermarket site at Giralang in the ACT

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths Limited proposed to acquire a lease for a new supermarket at Giralang in the Australian Capital Territory.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to reach a definitive view on market definition, since the results of the competition analysis would remain unchanged regardless of the precise market definition adopted.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant market. In forming this view, the ACCC noted that by establishing a new supermarket in Giralang, Woolworths would be adding to the number of supermarkets competing in the local area, and would be likely to continue to face competition in that area.
